# ClearlyCompliant

ClearlyCompliant is an automated GDPR compliance reporting tool for UK businesses and website owners.

## What it does

Users submit their website domain and pay £29.99. ClearlyCompliant automatically scans the website and delivers a detailed PDF GDPR compliance report by email within minutes.

## What the report covers

The report covers 23 automated compliance checks across six sections:

1. Technical Security — HTTPS, mixed content, security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy)
2. Privacy and Legal Documents — privacy policy, cookie policy, terms and conditions, data retention policy
3. Consent and Cookie Management — cookie consent banner, cookie preferences link, form consent checkboxes
4. Data Collection — contact forms, newsletter signups, login systems, ecommerce functionality
5. Third-Party and Tracking — Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, other trackers, live chat tools, social media embeds, payment processors, CDN usage, CMS detection
6. User Rights — unsubscribe mechanism, contact information, DPO information, data subject rights

The report also includes AI-powered analysis of the site's privacy policy and terms and conditions, identifying specific gaps and issues.

## Pricing

£29.99 one-off payment per report. No subscription. No recurring fees.

## Who it is for

UK businesses and website owners who need to understand their GDPR compliance status. Suitable for small businesses, sole traders, startups, and any organisation with a UK-facing website that collects personal data.

## Why it matters

UK GDPR fines can reach £17.5 million or 4% of global turnover. The ICO actively investigates complaints and issues fines for common violations including missing cookie consent, inadequate privacy policies, and unlawful use of tracking scripts.
